notes.title: Grandma, No! Is Out Now!
notes.notes:
Hello, dearies! 

Grandma, No! Is out now. Fart, flop, and fumble your way through Grandma’s home (and beyond 👀).

Of course, what you should really be doing is babysitting. But Grandma has a passion for adventure. Take in all the sights (a messy living room, an infested kitchen, and a backyard that hasn’t been mowed in a millennia)! Meet the [strike]abominations[/strike] friends living in Grandma’s house! And don’t forget the neighbours and lovable critters - but be careful, they’re armed.

Get a glimpse of everything Grandma, No! Has to offer in our launch trailer below 👵💖

[previewyoutube=qswe8FgHyn8;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]To celebrate the release of our new game, we’re launching with a 20% discount! 
[/b]
Play Grandma, No! Now 👇

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2362680/Grandma_No/

notes.title: Meet Sluggy - Whatever That Is 💥
notes.notes:
What words are there to describe Sluggy? Fluorescent snot green? Sticky and bulbous? Sentient sewage? We’ll find some positive adjectives eventually.

You’ll find Sluggy lurking inside of Grandma’s house - away from prying eyes. You’ll have to overcome a number of obstacles to reach him.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453921/d2ae56fd9a09d9df601e9b836f4bd909c2451722.gif[/img]

Sluggy’s a friendly guy - but he’s not very open to new experiences, he likes to stick to what he knows best. Unfortunately for Sluggy, Grandma wants to get to know him a little more personally, so he might find himself ripped out of his safe space and in a whole new (3D) world…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453921/55257ab771cc7e8127f590630235898029a2caf5.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453921/875dece64acdf3e7eab97b8e4377ff620455a160.gif[/img]

Sluggy is living ([strike]is he alive?[/strike]) proof that giving into your intrusive thoughts and never cleaning your house has its benefits. Sluggy is FREE… but a trampoline? That’s expensive.

Sluggy looks a little more approachable than when the team initially conceptualized him, which makes bouncing on him a lot less frightening.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453921/fc5eb345192e63e97f427ada32c86ca22b332d34.png[/img]

Sluggy is brought to life by our very own, multi-talented Ty Burks, and is one of only a selection of characters to appear both in 2D and 3D in Grandma, No!

Who would you like to see next? We’re currently voting in Discord! Swing on by and cast your vote!
https://discord.gg/W66KXJ8CH3

notes.title: Meet Birdly - The Li-bird-rarian! 🤘🐥🤘
notes.notes:
Happy Monday, Kiddos! Grandma would like to introduce you to someone… 

[h2]Introducing Birdly - The Li-bird-rarian![/h2]

Can’t say “li-bird-rarian”? Neither can Grandma! But she doesn’t let that get in the way of making new friends 👵👍

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453921/3ca699690c3605368de7ceab8c17d1bea6bcc8de.gif[/img]

It’s been a while since we last introduced one of Grandma’s... lodgers. Last time, you met the Dust Bunny who’s been thriving inside her hand vac for years.

Thankfully, Birdly’s never had to experience the inside of the vacuum. She much prefers the open air - though when she’s been away too long, she starts acting a bit... odd. Maybe there’s something in the air that’s messing with her? Maybe it’s the smell of Grandma’s farts? Who knows!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453921/413932488e2956ffdd8b7e960760336ebbae2c36.gif[/img]

If you can ignore her vaguely ominous aura, Birdly is able to help out with some of Grandma’s tasks around the house - but you’ll have to play the game to see how that plays out 😌

Take a look at how far Birdly has come since our early concept art, below!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453921/293568d25dc8949236d3140e30c9cdb98734c6ab.png[/img]

Birdly is brought to life by the amazingly talented Erin Pearce - who you may recognise from Yo Gabba Gabba!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453921/d998e8b5a9760d32cf92416fbb809807ccf96aec.png[/img]

We can’t wait for you to meet Birdly when Grandma, No! Launches later this year - [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2362680/Grandma_No/]wishlist us now[/url]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2362680/Grandma_No/

notes.title: Meet the Dust Bunny 🐰💨
notes.notes:
Hello, Deary 👵

Grandma was very excited to welcome you all into her home during Steam Next Fest and she hopes you and fun. The Wallride kiddos have been working very hard on the demo (which you can play now!). Here's one of the characters you can expect to meet beyond the demo.

[h1]Meet the Dust Bunny🐰💨 [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453921/f21eb67d736ab18461972ddf10848e8d7f634b32.gif[/img]

Dust Bunny is a chill, sentient pile of dead skin cells that have been stuck and growing in Grandmaʼs hand vac for several years. Who would've thought a dust pile would be so interested in... books? Grandma doesn't have any lying around - so she'll need to figure out where to find one.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453921/80f09537d58b6ff0da23f73ece2054c32a45a8d5.gif[/img]

The Dust Bunny has been part of Grandma's life for a very long time, an idea that was created early on in development and has stuck around since. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453921/1ad63298f31b8bcc136103a25f11c5fb90c13c94.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453921/ef7cb10ec108148f06d833e3b66dff65ee6af425.png[/img]

Dust Bunny is also voiced by our very own game director, Ty Burks! 🗣️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453921/59c292bf38f4c08a45404d328ff20b1177223ebd.png[/img]

Look out for the Dust Bunny in the full release of Grandma, No! 👇
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2362680/Grandma_No/
